function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values, and `sample_seq` shows that 48 patients were re-tested (i.e., have multiple rows). This means the dataset has multiple rows per patient.", "implication": "If we do not deduplicate, we will double-count re-tested patients in any summary statistic (e.g., response rate), which biases the estimate. function.name: note_finding
